text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The camellia oil you gave me, Acute-san, 
was truly amazing!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
My tail was all stiff and scratchy from 
the dirt dust, but it became silky-smooth 
in no time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's good to hear~ Camellia oil 
has been used for tail care since way back 
when~

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Plus, that stain on the room's carpet too! 
I couldn't get it out no matter what, so I 
thought I'd get scolded for sure.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
See how clean it got with baking soda? It 
takes off tea stains and all sorts of 
things, so give it a try whenever you're 
in a pinch.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... You're amazing, Acute-san! You 
keep popping out with so much wisdom...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm not doing anything special at a~ll. 
It's a~ll thanks to the wisdom of our 
ancestors, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"By the way, Tarumae-chan, I have a favor 
to ask..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Could you show me how to attach a photo to 
an email again? I'm completely hopeless 
when it comes to newfangled gadgets.
